topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints limit payload power allocation by imposing buffer size constraints, affecting time-tagged services. Dynamic buffer allocation optimizes buffer sizing, while latency-aware scheduling accounts for variable latency, ensuring efficient load distribution and minimizing delays. This balance enables optimal service execution.
reference_context: SatCom systems face trade-offs between fixed allocated capacity and dynamic allocation, with on-board storage constraints impacting power allocation and service prioritization.
